title: ProcessedEventMessage
description: Message published to the processed_events RabbitMQ exchange by the processing service after a raw event has been enriched, summarised, and indexed in Elasticsearch. raw_message is not included — it is stored in Elasticsearch but stripped before publishing.

dbId.description: Elasticsearch document _id assigned at index time.

source.description: Passed through from the originating raw event (e.g. telegram).

timestamp_epoch.description: Event time as Unix epoch seconds.

locations.description: Geocoded locations extracted from the event text.

name.description: Location name as returned by the geocoding service.

lat.description: Latitude as a decimal string, e.g. '32.1094'.

lon.description: Longitude as a decimal string, e.g. '34.8374'.

data.description: Source-specific payload passed through from the raw event. Shape depends on the value of source.
